name: Doctrinal Subroutine
summary: At the start of combat, choose Accuracy, Endurance, or Pursuit. Accuracy: +1 to your first attack roll. Endurance: temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus. Pursuit: +10 ft speed on your first turn.
